abstract: This document is a five-slide outline of photosynthesis. Slide 1 introduces photosynthesis as an overview topic. Slide 2 covers the light reactions, naming the movement of electrons from PSII to PSI, the splitting of water, and electron transport. Slide 3 describes the Calvin cycle through carbon fixation, reduction, and regeneration of RuBP, and Slide 4 lists the net products as ATP, NADPH, and glucose. Slide 5 identifies light, CO2, and temperature as limiting factors, but the slides give only brief labels without detailed explanation.
headline: Five-slide overview of photosynthesis covering light reactions, the Calvin cycle, net products, and limiting factors.
key_points: The light reactions move electrons from PSII to PSI, with water splitting supplying electrons to the chain.
Electron transport during the light reactions is part of the light-dependent stage named on Slide 2.
The Calvin cycle proceeds through carbon fixation, reduction, and regeneration of RuBP.
Net products of photosynthesis listed in the document are ATP, NADPH, and glucose.
Light, CO2, and temperature are identified as limiting factors on Slide 5.
